method: OpenStreetMap node 4425992583, used verbatim (a POI node, not a building footprint). Independently found during a QA re-derivation pass: the geometry worklog (docs/atlas-worklog/GEOMETRY_fermilab.md) reported that 'a targeted OSM name search for NM4 returned no results' and left detector:seaquest / site:fermilab-nm4-hall unlocated on that basis; that specific narrow search was true, but a search for the experiment's own name ('SeaQuest') -- never tried in that session -- finds this node directly, independently confirmed by this reviewer with a direct fetch of https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/node/4425992583.json (not just trusting a subagent's report of it). accuracy_m 10 m follows the contract's floor for an OSM point/building-scale feature; feature_type 'other' (not 'hall') because this is a single address-point node, not a traced building footprint.
